USECASE_ADD_BOOK.WHAT: Add a book while the list has room

FEATURE_CAPACITY.INTENT: Allow adding below the configured limit; default 20 books
FEATURE_CAPACITY.ACCEPT: 19/20 allows; 20/20 and 21/20 reject; zero limit rejects; negative inputs raise ValueError

MODULE_CAPACITY.WHY: One boundary decision shared by callers prevents inconsistent list limits
